description: Repairs r-str-ado-act/str-schema-change: DBEngine.Errors was read once and kept the last failure through a later successful ALTER, and the Fields collection was read without a Refresh after the DDL. On a read-write copy of r-str-ado-act-str-accdb: a dynaset of SELECT ID, T FROM S with Fields("T") retained, T read; Database.Execute("ALTER TABLE S ADD COLUMN X TEXT(10)", dbFailOnError) with DBEngine.Errors read right after; T read, MoveNext, T read, Requery, T read, Fields.Count of a fresh Fields; recordset closed; the same ALTER again with no recordset open, dbFailOnError, DBEngine.Errors read right after; TableDefs refreshed, TableDefs("S").Fields refreshed, its Count and Fields("X") Name read; UPDATE S SET X = Left(T, 10) for IDs 3 to 5 with dbFailOnError and Errors read; a fresh snapshot of ID, X, Len(X) for IDs 3 to 5 read. Asks whether the open recordset blocks the change, what the retained Field returns, and what the refreshed collections and copied values hold.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-wire-ado probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
